subject: Proposed Engagement Timeline & Responsibility Ask — CloudMed MAP Draft
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria@cloudmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Proposed Engagement Timeline & Responsibility Ask — CloudMed MAP Draft

Hi Maria — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached. I wanted to surface two timeline options and a small set of ownership asks so we can align stakeholders and lock a target close.

Recap (from call):
- Use case: nearline patient record summarization + search; 1M monthly requests, 200k unique patients
- Primary success metrics: 200ms P95 for query flows; < $0.06 / 1k tokens operational target
- Constraints: must support SOC 2-level controls, VPC/network peering, and optional on-prem connector for PHI workloads

Proposed MAP (high level milestones & responsibilities):
1) Kickoff & SOW draft (Redwood: Connor + Monica) — deliverable: SOW & initial billing estimate
2) Security review & evidence exchange (CloudMed: security contact) — deliverable: SOC2 artifacts + questionnaire responses
3) POC environment & integration (Redwood: Aditya) — deliverable: test cluster, sample integration runbooks
4) Performance tuning & acceptance (Joint) — deliverable: acceptance test signoff
5) Procurement & contract execution (CloudMed procurement) — deliverable: signed Order Form

Target close options (pick one):
- Option 1 (Conservative): Target close by 2027-02-04 — allows 4 weeks for security review and two-week POC window
- Option 2 (Accelerated): Target close by 2026-12-22 — requires security questionnaire completed in 1 week and immediate POC start

Dependencies / risks:
- SOC2 evidence: timing for access to artifacts could push timeline
- Procurement lead availability: needed to finalize payment/PO terms
- Data sample readiness: CloudMed needs a staged anonymized sample for performance testing
Ask: could you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday?
1) Preferred target close (Option 1 or Option 2)
2) Primary contacts for Security, Procurement, and Engineering (name + email) for the MAP
3) Any blackouts or freeze windows between now and Dec 31 that would block integration work

Attachment: MAP_Draft_CloudMed-v1.pdf (staged with the milestone matrix and owner column)

If this looks aligned I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week to walk through the draft and confirm the SOW owners.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Connor — thanks for the thorough recap and for sending the draft. Quick notes from our side after syncing with the team: 

- We prefer Option 1 (target close by 2027-02-04) to ensure security review has enough runway.
- Security contact: Javier Torres (javier.torres@cloudmed.com) — he'll lead SOC2 artifact exchange.
- Procurement: Dana Kim (dana.kim@cloudmed.com) — procurement lead; expects standard PO timeline (3 weeks after final SOW).
- Engineering lead: Priya Shah (priya.shah@cloudmed.com) — will own test data prep and integration work.

One small ask: can we shift the POC acceptance window by one week later to allow our data team to finish anonymization? So preference would be POC start week of Jan 10 vs Jan 3. Otherwise the milestones look good.

Also: I'll need a copy of your SOC2 summary (a short checklist) for our security team to triage the questionnaire quickly. Can you attach that to the MAP?

Cheers,
Maria
Director of Product & Data | CloudMed Solutions
maria@cloudmed.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
